articles.title_zh: 样本, 模拟, 选择: 人体无训练的物理- 环形文字对运动
articles.content_zh: 文字到运动模型产生可信的人类运动,但不模拟机器人的动态;全身跟踪控制器可靠地执行机器人引用,但不能重新规划一个不可行的. 最近的语言对人系统通过培训弥补了这一差距。 我们通过将部署控制器本身置于循环中,来衡量有多少缺口在完全没有训练的情况下缩小。 样本模拟选择( S$ 3 美元) 绘图 从冷冻的文字对动模型中,每秒1元的动作,通过方向比对反动动因子重新瞄准Unitree G1,用预先训练过的SONIC跟踪政策在全刚体动态下卷出所有动作,使候选人的政策得到最好的执行. 由于核查者是确定模拟者本身,所以3新元通过建造达到任何一美元上限;我们衡量的是上限所在之处和不足之处。 在200个分级的HumanML3D测试提示上,用$N=8美元,直立执行率从83.5%上升至89.5%,硬件门从33%上升至85;在完全测试拆分(4,184个提示)时,从80.5%上升至89.5%。 一个预测好落的动能核实器(AUROC 0.90)只恢复了这一收益的四分之一:对一个迅速者自己的候选人进行排名比对人口的分类更困难. 选择不能修补的是一个类, 提示降低骨盆, 一个在重定向机器人数据上训练的生成器是执行的。 我们进一步将被执行运动的语义忠诚度与标准文本运动评估器进行比对,并采用将损失归属于机器人投影的真运动控制,将重定向器对GMR(补充性故障:任何8天上限比两者都升至95.0%),并在真正的G1上执行所有177个门选片段:每个完成,硬件跟踪错误匹配模拟(r=0.94美元)。

articles.title: MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation
articles.content: Successful mobile manipulation requires coordinated base and arm motion while maintaining accurate spatial positioning. However, demonstration-trained policies can struggle to realise the intended base motion reliably, leading to spatial misalignment and subsequent manipulation failures. We present MAVP (Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies), a framework that improves execution reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localisation feedback. MAVP reconstructs a static map from teleoperated demonstrations and expresses demonstrated base trajectories in a shared map frame, providing consistent spatial supervision across demonstrations. At execution time, the policy receives RGB observations, joint states, and the robot's current map-frame base pose, and jointly predicts target base poses, arm actions, and gripper actions. A low-level controller tracks the predicted base targets using feedforward motion and pose error feedback, enabling correction of execution deviations. We additionally use pose-noise augmentation during training to improve robustness to errors in the policy's pose input. Across six real-world manipulation tasks and three policy families, MAVP achieves higher task success rates than unanchored velocity control in all tasks. Videos and additional results are available at https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/.

articles.title_zh: MAVP: 用于移动操纵的地图软件
articles.content_zh: 成功的移动操纵需要协调的基部和臂部运动,同时保持精确的空间定位. 然而,经过示范训练的政策可能难以可靠地实现预期的基础运动,导致空间错位和随后的操纵失败。 我们提出MAVP(Map-Aware Visuomotor Policys),这个框架通过预测明确的基数目标并利用本地化反馈来跟踪它们来提高执行可靠性. MAVP通过远程操作的演示重建静态地图,并在共享的地图框中表达演示底轨,提供贯穿演示的一致空间监督. 在执行时,政策接收RGB的观测,联合状态,以及机器人当前映射框基座的姿势,并共同预测目标基座的姿势,武装动作,以及夹击动作. 低级控制器使用feedward运动跟踪预测的基准目标并形成错误反馈,从而能够纠正执行偏差. 在培训期间,我们还另外使用假冒噪音增强手段,以提高政策中的错误的强度。 在6个现实世界操纵任务和3个政策领域,MAVP在所有任务中都取得了比无预设速度控制更高的任务成功率. 视频和其他结果可查阅https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/。

articles.title: KwaiMind Technical Report
articles.content: Commercial image editing requires product identity preservation, accurate text rendering, and user appeal alongside general editing quality. We present KwaiMind, an image editing system combining general capabilities with e-commerce specialization. An agent-based data engine maintains approximately 1.8 million high-quality editing pairs. Built on a multimodal diffusion transformer, KwaiMind undergoes continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, followed by preference optimization and online reinforcement learning. A general-purpose vision-language judge and specialized rewards for click-through rate (CTR), text rendering, and product consistency guide specialized policies, which are consolidated through on-policy distillation. We introduce Ecom-Bench, covering 11 commercial editing tasks with task-specific visual evaluation and CTR-based ranking. KwaiMind achieves the strongest overall scores among evaluated open-source editors on ImgEdit, GEdit, both language splits of REDEdit, and Ecom-Bench visual quality, and the highest aggregate CTR ranking score among compared systems. Offline, CTR-guided optimization increases the proportion of generated images whose predicted CTR exceeds that of the original product image from 12.16% to 37.41%. In an online A/B experiment, CTR-based selection of product main images yields an approximately 2.44% relative increase in actual CTR. These results demonstrate the value of domain-specific data and reward-driven alignment for commercial image editing.

articles.title_zh: 桂明德技术报告
articles.content_zh: 商业图像编辑需要产品身份保存、准确的文本渲染和用户的吸引力以及一般编辑质量。 我们介绍KwaiMind,这是一个将一般能力与电子商务专业化相结合的图像编辑系统。 基于代理的数据引擎维持约180万对高质量的编辑对. KwaiMind在多式联运变压器上建造,继续接受预训,并监督微调,随后进行优惠优化和在线强化学习。 通用视觉语言法官和对点击率(CTR)、文本渲染和产品一致性的专门奖励,指导专门政策,这些政策通过政策提炼得到巩固。 我们引入了Ecom-Bench,负责11项商业编辑任务,具有特定任务视觉评价和基于CTR的排名. KwaiMind在ImgEdit,Gedit上的评价开源编辑器中实现了最强的整体分数,既实现了语言分化REDDDit,也实现了Ecom-Bench视觉质量,也是比较系统中总和CTR排名最高的分数. 离线,CTR制导优化将预测的CTR超过原产品图像的生成图像比例从12.16%提高到37.41%. 在一次在线A/B实验中,基于CTR的产品主图像选择产生实际CTR相对增加约2.44%. 这些结果显示了特定域数据的价值以及商业图像编辑的奖励驱动的对齐.

articles.title: On the Role of the Projector in Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning: Last-Layer Rank Dynamics Drive Representation Quality
articles.content: The dimensional collapse of representations in self-supervised contrastive learning is an ever-present issue. One notable technique to prevent such a collapse of representations is using a multi-layered perceptron network called Projector. In several works, the projector has been found to heavily influence the quality of representations learned in a self-supervised contrastive pre-training task. However, the question still lingers. What role does the projector play? Assuming the projector mitigates dimensional collapse, what prevents the terminal layer of the base encoder from functioning as the projector in the absence of an explicit multi-layer perceptron (MLP) head? In this work, we intend to study what happens inside the projector by examining the rank dynamics of the same and the encoder through empirical study and analysis. Through mathematical analysis, we observe that the effect of rank reduction predominantly occurs in the last layer. Motivated by this insight, we propose a weight regularization strategy applied specifically to the last layer. We demonstrate that this targeted approach yields better performance than applying orthogonal weight regularization across the entire network (WeRank), both with and without a projector. Our method improves Top-1 accuracy by more than 1% on SimCLR on the ImageNet100 dataset and consistently outperforms baseline SimCLR variants on CIFAR datasets, supporting our interpretation of the projector's role.

articles.title_zh: 关于投影员在自导自导学习中的作用:最后-Layer排名动态 驱动代表质量
articles.content_zh: 在自我监督的对比性学习中表现的维度崩溃是一个始终存在的问题. 防止这种表达式崩溃的一个显著技术是使用一个称为Projector的多层透视网络. 在多部作品中,发现投影仪在自我监督的对比性前期训练任务中,对所学表现的质量产生了很大影响. 然而,这个问题仍然存在。 投影机扮演什么角色? 假设投影仪能减轻维的崩溃,那么在没有明确的多层透视头(MLP)的情况下,是什么阻止了基编码器的终端层作为投影仪的功能? 在这项工作中,我们打算研究投影仪内部发生的情况,通过经验研究和分析来检查同类的排名动态和编码器. 通过数学分析,我们看到降级的效果主要发生在最后一层. 基于这一见解,我们提议一项权重正常化战略,专门适用于最后一层。 我们表明,这种有针对性的方法比在整个网络(WeRank)中实行正重调节,无论有无投影仪,都会产生更好的效果。 我们的方法在ImageNet100数据集的SimCLR上提高了Top-1的精度超过1%,并且始终超越CIFAR数据集的基线SimCLR变体,支持我们对投影仪作用的解释.

articles.title: Leveraging Vision-Based Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Online Vectorized HD Mapping
articles.content: Camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping provide compact scene representations for autonomous driving, but both depend on accurate metric geometry and remain limited by depth ambiguity. Over long-term deployment, observations from repeated traversals can be accumulated into persistent point cloud priors that provide geometric context beyond the current observations. Existing explicit point cloud prior approaches, however, rely on LiDAR-based map construction and therefore require expensive 3D ranging sensors. We propose a framework that constructs a static point cloud prior map from previous camera traversals using Pi3X and augments each point with DINOv3 features. At runtime, a local prior patch is retrieved using global localization, encoded with a sparse voxel backbone, and fused in bird's-eye view (BEV) with lifted multi-view camera features. Task-specific sparse transformer heads then predict 3D objects and vectorized map elements from the fused representation. On Argoverse 2, the vision-based prior improves a strong baseline from 0.287 to 0.299 CDS and from 0.669 to 0.750 vectorized mapping mAP. Ablations show that semantic DINOv3 features are particularly important for vectorized mapping. These results demonstrate that vision-built geometric-semantic priors provide an effective form of long-term scene memory for camera-based perception, improving both tasks without LiDAR for prior-map construction or online inference.

articles.title_zh: 利用基于视觉的点云地图,用于相机的3D对象检测和在线矢量HD映射
articles.content_zh: 基于相机的3D天体探测和在线矢量HD映射为自主驾驶提供了紧凑的场景表现,但两者都依赖于准确的度量几何,并且仍然受到深度模糊的限制. 在长期部署期间,从反复的曲面观测结果可以累积成持续点云前缀,提供超出当前观测的几何背景. 然而,现有的显点云前置方法依赖于基于LiDAR的地图构造,因此需要昂贵的3D测距传感器. 我们提出一个框架,用Pi3X从以前的相机转盘构造一个静点云前图,并用DINOv3的特性增强每个点. 在运行时,使用全局本地化检索到本地先前的补丁,用稀疏的 voxel 骨干进行编码,并在鸟眼视野(BEV)中熔化,具有解除的多视图相机功能. 任务特定的稀疏变压器头然后从引信的表示中预测3D对象和矢量化的映射元素. 在Argoverse 2上,基于视觉的先导改进了一个强基线,从0.287到0.299 CDS,从0.669到0.750矢量映射mAP. 缩写显示语义DINov3特征对于矢量化映射特别重要. 这些结果表明,视觉构建的几何语义前传为相机感知提供了一种有效的长期场景内存形式,改进了没有LiDAR的两种任务,用于前传地图构建或在线推论.

articles.title: ForeDrive: Foresight-Guided End-to-End Autonomous Driving with a Planning-Relevant Latent World Model
articles.content: Existing latent world models are typically optimized for future predictability, yet the resulting representations are not necessarily useful for planning in autonomous driving. Predictions are commonly used for pretraining or auxiliary supervision rather than as direct conditioning signals for trajectory generation. We propose ForeDrive, which learns a planning-relevant latent representation and couples it asymmetrically to a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) planner. The planner consumes multi-horizon latent future representations learned with a JEPA-style world model; planning gradients update the shared online encoder, while stop-gradient routing trains the latent predictor with forecasting losses only. Because predicted futures have varying reliability across horizons and BEV trajectories are misaligned with image tokens, we use gated visual fusion, future-status injection, and Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB) to inject future latents as guidance without overriding the current observation. Trained with pure imitation learning and using only the current front-view image as visual input at inference, ForeDrive attains 89.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.0 one-stage EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, without reinforcement learning or an external trajectory scorer.

articles.title_zh: ForeDrive:前瞻指导 端到端自主驾驶 具有规划相关性的Latent世界模式
articles.content_zh: 现有的潜在世界模型通常被优化,以便未来的可预测性,但由此产生的表述不一定有助于自主驱动的规划。 预测通常用于预训或辅助监理,而不是作为弹道生成的直接调节信号. 我们提出ForeDrive,它学习了一种与规划相关的潜在代表,并将其不对称地与一个传播变形器(DiT)规划者结合. 规划者消耗了用JEPA风格的世界模型学到的多视距潜在未来表现;规划梯度更新了共享的在线编码器,而停止级路由则仅以预测损失来训练潜在预测器. 由于预测未来跨地平线的可靠性不同,而BEV轨迹与图像符号错配,我们使用门式视觉聚变,未来状态注入,以及Traprextory-Adaptive Bias(TAB)来注入未来潜伏物作为引导,而不压倒目前的观测. ForeDrive在NAVSIM v1上获得89.9 PDMS,在NAVSIM v2上获得90.0个一级 EMDMS,没有强化学习或外部轨迹计分器。

articles.title: EMERGE: Resolution-Agnostic Point Cloud Generation with Equivariant Graph-Based Diffusion
articles.content: Point cloud generation has emerged as a crucial task for accurately capturing and reproducing the complexity of the physical world. However, existing generative approaches, predominantly relying on Transformers and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), frequently ignore the continuous, non-grid topologies inherent to 3D spaces. Although the integration of graph-based structures has yielded significant benefits in related discriminative vision tasks, such geometric architectures remain noticeably absent from 3D generative modeling. To address this gap, we introduce EMERGE (Equivariant Multi-scale GNN for Resolution-agnostic point cloud GEneration), the first fully $SE(3)$-equivariant graph-based diffusion backbone explicitly designed to generate point clouds while preserving continuous spatial symmetries. Our framework bypasses the rigid resolution dependencies of standard generative pipelines, enabling zero-shot inference at multiple, arbitrary spatial resolutions. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that EMERGE achieves State-of-the-Art generation quality across standard metrics, while the strong inherent geometric inductive biases enable significantly faster training convergence compared to existing baseline methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EMERGE:溶解-不可知点云生成与等效图基扩散
articles.content_zh: 点云生成已成为准确捕捉和复制物理世界复杂性的关键任务。 然而,现有的基因方法,主要依靠变形器和变形自动编码器(VAEs),经常忽略3D空间所固有的连续的,非网格的地形. 虽然以图表为基础的结构的整合在相关的差别化愿景任务中产生了重大效益,但这种几何结构在3D基因模型中仍然明显缺失. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了EMERGE(Equalariant Multi-scale GNN for Resolution-Agnositic point Generation),这是第一个完全基于SE(3)美元-等价图的传播主干线,明确设计在保持连续空间对称的同时生成点云. 我们的框架绕过标准基因管道的僵硬分辨率依赖性,从而能够对多种任意空间分辨率进行零镜头推论。 广泛的实证评价表明,ERMEREGE在标准衡量标准上实现了最先进的生成质量,而很强的内在几何导体偏差使得培训的趋同速度大大加快,而现有的基线方法则比得更快。

articles.title: Faithful Faithfulness Evaluations: Challenges & Pitfalls Learned from a Breast MRI Case Study
articles.content: Saliency maps are widely used to explain deep learning predictions in medical imaging, yet visually plausible explanations do not necessarily reflect a model's true decision process and may therefore mislead clinicians. We investigate this problem using a Vision Transformer-based breast MRI classifier trained on the ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge dataset and evaluate multiple saliency methods, including Last-layer Attention, Attention Rollout, Grad-SAM, Gradient Attention Rollout, GMAR, Grad-CAM, and HiResCAM. Our study highlights two often-overlooked challenges in perturbation-based faithfulness evaluation. First, method rankings depend strongly on the perturbation strategy, varying across intensity-based perturbations and transformer-based attention masking. Second, benchmarking saliency methods requires distinguishing between class-specific and class-agnostic explanations. To enable fair comparisons, we introduce non-class-specific variants of gradient-based methods and evaluate both settings separately. Across protocols, Grad-CAM and Gradient Attention Rollout consistently emerged as the strongest class-specific methods, although their relative ranking depended on the evaluation design. These findings expose important limitations of current saliency-based explainability approaches and highlight the need for more robust and standardized evaluation frameworks for trustworthy clinical AI systems.

articles.title_zh: 忠诚 评价:挑战与陷阱 从乳房磁共振研究中吸取的教训
articles.content_zh: 显著的地图被广泛用于解释医学成像中的深层学习预测,然而视觉上可信的解释并不一定反映模型的真正决策过程,因此可能误导临床医生. 我们利用一个在CODELIA母乳核磁共振挑战数据集上经过培训的基于视觉变形器的乳腺核磁共振分类器来调查这个问题,并评价多种显要方法,包括最后一级注意,注意推出,渐渐注意推出,GMAR,Grad-CAM和HiResCAM. 我们的研究突出了在基于扰动的忠诚评价中经常被忽略的两个挑战。 首先,方法的排名在很大程度上取决于扰动策略,不同强度的扰动和变压器的注意力掩蔽不同. 第二,制定基准的显著性方法需要区分特定类别和不可知类别的解释。 为了能够进行公平的比较,我们采用了基于梯度方法的非特定类别变体,并分别评价这两种设置。 在整个协议中,Grad-CAM和Gradient Entertainment Rollout一直作为最强的分类特定方法出现,尽管它们的相对排名取决于评价设计. 这些结论暴露了当前基于显著性的解释性方法的重要局限性,并突出表明,对于值得信赖的临床人工智能系统,需要有更有力和更标准化的评价框架。

articles.title: NAWE: Digital Watermarking with Neural-Assisted Watermark Extraction
articles.content: NAWE (Neural-Assisted Watermark Extraction) combines an explicit signal-processing watermarking construction with a pretrained neural host predictor. A periodic, perceptually masked watermark carrier provides synchronization, Polar coding supplies redundancy, and denoising followed by subtraction extracts the embedded watermark. The denoiser remains frozen, without watermark-specific training. A one-factor-at-a-time study compares Wiener, BM3D, DRUNet, and GS-DRUNet host estimators. Comparisons with TrustMark, SSL Watermarking, PixelSeal, and WAM show NAWE's lowest geometric and photometric class BER and strong message recovery, while filtering and noise remain limitations consistent with the non-adaptive selection of the watermark extractor. The comparison retains the systems' different payloads and coding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NAWE:带有神经辅助水印的数码水印
articles.content_zh: NAWE(神经辅助水印提取器)结合了一种明确的信号处理水印构造和预先训练的神经宿主预测器. 一个周期性的,能感知到的遮盖水印载体提供同步,极地编码补给冗余,然后去诺,再减法提取嵌入水印. 德诺瓦瑟仍然冷冻,没有水印专用训练. 一项一次性因素研究比较了Wiener、BM3D、DRUNet和GS-DRUNet主机估计器。 与TrustMark,SSL水印,PixelSeal,和WAM的比较显示NAWE的几何和光度分类BER和强烈的信息恢复最低,而过滤和噪音仍然是与水印提取器的非适应性选择一致的限制. 比较保留了系统的不同有效载荷和编码。

articles.title: GRIP: Gaussian Rendering as a Cross-Modal Bridge for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
articles.content: This paper introduces GRIP, a pose-conditioned refinement framework for pixel-to-point matching and 2D to 3D registration. Given an initial coarse pose estimate, GRIP addresses the structural mismatch between grid based image descriptors and unordered point cloud descriptors by softly rendering learned 3D point features onto the image grid through Gaussian feature splatting. The rendered point derived feature map is then fused with image features by a pixel aligned transformer, enabling visual semantic and geometric cues to interact in a shared 2D representation. The refined features are decoded and propagated to finer resolutions for dense correspondence estimation and final pose refinement. Experiments on RGB D Scenes V2 and 7 Scenes demonstrate state of the art inlier ratio and competitive registration recall, with stronger performance under stricter evaluation thresholds.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GRIP:高斯铸造成跨摩尔桥进行图像到点云注册
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍了GRIP,是像素对点匹配和2D对3D注册的配置条件完善框架. 鉴于最初粗糙的姿势估计,GRIP通过软渲染学到的3D点特征通过高斯特征电镀在图像网格上,解决了基于网格的图像描述符和无序点云描述符之间的结构不匹配. 渲染点衍生的特征映射然后由像素对齐的变压器与图像特征结合,使视觉语义和几何提示能够在共享的2D表示中相互作用. 精细的特征被解码并传播到更精细的分辨率,以便进行密集的函证估计和最后的改进。 对RGB D Scenes V2 和 7 Scenes 的实验显示了最先进的加码比和竞争性登记召回,在更严格的评价阈值下表现更强.

articles.title: Towards Systematic Qualification of Vision-Language Models for Automotive Perception Systems
articles.content: The field of Artificial Intelligence has been adopted for many application domains. Vision Language Models are one of the recently advanced AI techniques that have been explored to support automotive features such as vehicle perception, and safety assurance. However, such language models are prone to hallucinations, posing a potential threat to the safety of automotive systems that may incorporate them. Within the automotive domain, VLMs could not only hallucinate traffic objects, but could also fail to identify traffic objects that are actually present, which may potentially lead to dangerous situations. Though we have observed a growing body of literature that proposes verification and validation techniques for safe and trustworthy AI, these methods are often studied in isolation, focusing either on run-time or design-time phases. Such isolated techniques could be insufficient in safety-critical, realistic contexts such as automotive perception systems. In this paper, we analyze design-time and run-time verification and validation techniques based on a taxonomy presented by Huang et al. We present an automotive study in which a design-time qualification workflow is proposed to complement run-time monitoring. This workflow combines a fixed safety-relevant ontology-based structured annotation system together with a synonym-based evaluation process to statistically evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs against data from the nuScenes dataset. We observed that the proposed technique enables deterministic and repeatable quantification of the hallucinations VLMs generate in automotive perception-related tasks. The proposed workflow supports model comparison and deployment-oriented engineering decisions within the design-time verification and validation process and will contribute to a holistic verification strategy that strives towards trustworthy automotive perception systems

articles.title_zh: 逐步实现汽车感知系统视觉-语言模型的系统化合格化.
articles.content_zh: 人工智能领域已被许多应用领域采用. 视觉语言模型(Vision Language Models)是最近探索的高级AI技术之一,用于支持汽车特性,如车辆感知,和安全保障. 然而,这种语言模型容易产生幻觉,对可能包含这些幻觉的汽车系统的安全构成潜在威胁. 在汽车领域,VLM不仅可以幻觉交通物体,还可以无法识别实际存在的交通物体,这可能导致危险的情况. 尽管我们看到越来越多的文献为安全和可靠的AI提出了核查和验证技术,但这些方法往往被孤立地研究,侧重于运行时间或设计时间阶段。 这种孤立的技术在诸如汽车感知系统等安全、现实的环境中可能是不够的。 在本文中,我们根据黄 et等人提出的分类法,分析设计时间和运行时间的验证和验证技术. 我们提出一项汽车研究,其中提议采用设计-时间合格工作流程,以补充运行时间监测。 这一工作流程将基于安全的固定本体学结构化注释系统与基于同义词的评价过程结合起来,对照nuScens数据集的数据对三种最新VLM进行统计评价. 我们注意到,拟议的技术能够确定和重复量化在汽车感知相关任务中产生的幻觉VLM。 拟议工作流程支持设计-时间核查和验证过程中的模型比较和以部署为导向的工程决定,并有助于制定全面核查战略,努力实现可靠的汽车感知系统

articles.title: Calibrating Retrieval Geometry: Reliability-Guided Training-Free Aggregation for Visual Place Recognition
articles.content: Frozen visual foundation models provide transferable features for visual place recognition, but fixed aggregation can suppress useful distinctions in new environments. We introduce TFA, a reliability-guided, training-free aggregation method requiring neither place labels nor task-specific weight updates. Our key observation is that reproducible retrieval need not be discriminative: independent codebooks can consistently retrieve a few database hubs. TFA combines cross-codebook agreement, retrieval coverage, and spectral statistics to control residual assignment, spectral shaping, and global-feature fusion. Its spectral kernel exactly recovers original descriptor similarity at zero intervention. Database-only TFA fixes its rules before accessing queries; TFA-C64 uses 64 disjoint unlabeled target images to calibrate retrieval for subsequent queries. Across 20 ground protocols with a fixed DINOv2-B backbone and matched resolution, database-only TFA improves Recall@1 over AnyLoc by 17.39 percentage points on MSLS-val and 9.55 on SPED. C64 mitigates failures of database-only calibration in driving environments. Across eight aerial/cross-view protocols, TFA achieves the highest Recall@1 among compared training-free heads in 14 of 16 DINOv2/DINOv3 backbone-protocol combinations. In a separate native-system comparison, DINOv2-G-based TFA-C64 reaches 91.46% Recall@1 on Pitts30k and 76.29% on VPAIR, outperforming the displayed training-free comparators on all five benchmarks. These results show that reliability-guided aggregation can recover additional retrieval capability from frozen representations, providing a practical baseline for new environments with scarce place supervision.

articles.title_zh: 校准回溯几何:可信赖性 - 指导性培训 - 视觉位置识别的免费聚合
articles.content_zh: 冷冻的视觉基础模型为视觉位置识别提供了可转移的特征,但固定的聚合可以抑制新环境下的有用区分. 我们采用TFA,一种可靠、无培训的汇总方法,既不设置标签,也不更新特定任务的重量。 我们的主要观察是,可复制的检索不必是歧视性的:独立的密码簿可以不断检索几个数据库中枢。 TFA将跨码簿协议,检索范围,光谱统计结合起来,控制剩余任务,光谱塑造,以及全球地物聚变. 它的光谱内核在零干涉时完全恢复了原始描述的相似性. 只有数据库的TFA在访问查询前会修正其规则;TFA-C64使用64个脱连接的无标签目标图像来校准后续查询的检索. 在有固定的DINOv2-B主干线和匹配分辨率的20个地面协议中,仅数据库的TFA比AnyLoc改进了17.39个百分点的MSLS-val和9.55个百分点的SPED。 C64缓解了驱动环境中只使用数据库校准的故障. 通过8个航空/跨视协议,TFA在16个DINOv2/DINOv3主干-protocol组合中,实现了14个无训练头中最高的Recall@1。 在单独的本土系统比较中,基于DINov2-G的TFA-C64在Pitts30k上达到91.46%的召回@1,在VPAIR上达到76.29%,在所有五个基准上都超过了所显示的无培训参照数。 这些结果表明,以可靠性为指南的汇总可以从冻结的表述中恢复额外的检索能力,为新环境提供了实用的基线,缺乏对地点的监督。

articles.title: AT3D-AD: Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Point-Language Alignment
articles.content: Detecting and localizing 3D point-cloud defects is essential for industrial inspection. However, existing methods often suffer from imprecise localization due to the lack of anomaly supervision and reliance on single-granularity representations. To address these limitations, we propose Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection (AT3D-AD), a unified framework for joint detection, localization, and classification. Specifically, we first design the Physics-Driven Parametric Anomaly Synthesis (PDPAS) module employing multiple parametric functions to generate synthetic anomalies, providing explicit anomaly supervision. Then, we propose the Hierarchical Global-Local Anomaly Alignment (HiGLA) module to align global and local representations within the normal and anomalous groups. Finally, we propose the Semantic-Geometric Anomaly Classification (SGAC) module to jointly learn localization and classification, yielding spatially precise and type-discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments establish new state-of-the-art performance on all four benchmarks. AT3D-AD achieves Object/Point AUROC scores of 98.1\%/98.9\% on Anomaly-ShapeNet and 95.0\%/95.2\% on Real3D-AD, while reaching 74.2\% Macro-F1 for anomaly-type recognition on Real3D-AD.

articles.title_zh: AT3D-AD: 异常类型- 软件 3D 异常检测
articles.content_zh: 3D点云缺陷的检测和定位对工业检查至关重要。 然而,由于缺乏异常监管和依赖单格性表述,现有方法往往不准确本地化。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用异质的3D型异质检测(AT3D-AD),这是联合检测、本地化和分类的统一框架。 具体地说,我们首先设计了物理-驱动参数异常合成(PDPAS)模块,利用多种参数函数生成合成异常,提供明显的异常监督. 然后,我们提议采用全球-地方异常对接(HIGLA)模块,以便在正常和异常的团体中协调全球和地方代表。 最后,我们提议采用语义-地理异常分类(SGAC)模块,共同学习本地化和分类,得出空间精确和类型差异异常的表示。 广泛的实验确定了所有四项基准的最新业绩。 AT3D-AD在Anomaly-ShapeNet上实现Object/Point AUROC分数98.1\%/98.9\%,在Real3D-AD上实现95.0\%/95.2\%,同时在Real3D-AD上达到74.2\%Macro-F1的异常型识别.

articles.title: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV Caching and Parallel Decoding for Fast, Memory-Efficient Diffusion LLMs
articles.content: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs by enabling non-autoregressive text generation. However, their practical deployment remains limited by inefficient inference, largely due to the absence of effective Key-Value (KV) caching and scalable parallel decoding mechanisms. Existing acceleration methods typically study KV caching and parallel decoding in isolation, overlooking the I/O bottlenecks that arise when cache reuse and parallel token verification are jointly applied. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{Flash-dLLM}$, a training-free inference acceleration framework for fast and memory-efficient dLLMs. Flash-dLLM first identifies GPU memory I/O as a dominant bottleneck in KV-cache-enabled dLLM inference and addresses it with an I/O-aware fused KV-cache kernel that reduces redundant memory movement. Building on this optimized cache mechanism, Flash-dLLM further proposes an efficient KV-cache-driven draft-and-verify decoding strategy, where the dLLM itself serves as both drafter and verifier without requiring an auxiliary model. This unified design enables faster decoding while preserving generation quality and improving scalability to longer sequences and larger batch size. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that Flash-dLLM consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art dLLM acceleration methods in both inference speed and memory efficiency. In particular, it achieves $5.1\times$ and $11.0\times$ speedups over prior strongest baseline Elastic-Cache on GSM8K and HumanEval, respectively.

articles.title_zh: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV 缓存和并行解码以快速,内存-有效扩散 LLMs
articles.content_zh: 传播大语言模型(dLLMs)最近出现,通过允许非自动的文本生成,成为自递性LLMs的一种有希望的替代品. 然而,其实际部署仍然受到推论效率低下的限制,这主要是由于缺乏有效的Key-Value(KV)缓存和可伸缩的平行解码机制。 现有的加速方法通常孤立地研究KV缓存和平行解码,忽略了当缓存复用和平行符号验证联合应用时出现的I/O瓶颈. 在这项工作中,我们引入 $\textbf{ flash-dLLM}$,一个用于快速和内存高效的 dLLM 的无训练推论加速框架. Flash-dLLM首先将GPU内存I/O识别为KV-cache-belied dLLM推论中的一个主要瓶颈,并以一个I/O-aware 熔化的KV-cache内核处理,减少冗余内存运动. 基于这种优化的缓存机制,Flash-dLLM进一步提出了高效的KV-cache驱动的草稿和验证解码策略,其中dLLLM本身同时担任起草者和核查者,而不需要辅助模型. 这种统一设计能够更快地进行解码,同时保持生成质量,提高可扩展性,达到更长的序列和更大的批量尺寸. 关于数学推理和代码生成基准的广泛实验表明,Flash-dLLM在推论速度和内存效率上始终比现有最先进的dLLM加速度方法要好. 特别是,在GSM8K和HumanEval上分别比先前最强的基准“弹性-卡舍”速度达到5.1美元和11.0美元。

articles.title: Agensh: Scaling Organizational Intelligence to 1,024 Agents
articles.content: A multi-agent system can reduce latency on complex tasks by executing work concurrently. Several pioneering harness frameworks support multi-agent systems. However, the scalability of current multi-agent harnesses is often constrained by a central orchestrator's capacity to allocate tasks and coordinate workers. To address this limitation, we introduce Agensh, a scalable self-organized multi-agent harness without a central orchestrator: concurrent workers execute a multi-agent cooperation loop, continuously gathering context, claiming and self-assigning sub-tasks, taking action and sharing findings, verifying results, and merging progress in an asynchronous manner. The loop is supported by the agentic organization infrastructure comprising three components: a shared workspace holds proposed, ongoing, and completed work; a message interface lets workers communicate; and shared context retains reusable findings and work intentions. To test the scalability of Agensh, we evaluate it on the five hardest ProgramBench tasks with GPT-5.6-sol (high). Scaling from 1 to 128 agents raises the mean final test-pass rate from 19.31% to 28.78%, an approximately 49% relative improvement. Larger organizations reach comparable test-pass rates earlier. On pandoc, scaling from 1 to 1,024 agents raises the final test-pass rate from 33.89% to 55.06%. Worker trajectories further show that different forms of self-organized cooperation gradually emerges and standardizes as the organization grows. These results reveal the number of agents as a new scaling dimension for multi-agent organizations to expand the frontier of general intelligence, offering a practical solution for complex tasks under hard latency constraints or time budgets.

articles.title_zh: Agensh:将组织情报扩大到1 024名特工
articles.content_zh: 多代理系统可以通过同时执行工作来减少复杂任务的延迟性. 一些开创性的利用框架支持多种代理系统。 然而,当前多剂电机的可伸缩性往往受到中央管弦乐手分配任务和协调工人的能力的限制. 为了克服这一限制,我们引入了Agensh,一种没有中央管弦乐器的可伸缩的自我组织的多代理操纵:同时工作的工人执行一个多代理合作循环,不断收集背景,声称和自行分配子任务,采取行动和分享调查结果,核实结果,并同步合并进度. 该循环得到代理组织基础设施的支持,该基础设施由三个部分组成:共享工作空间持有拟议、持续和已完成的工作;信息接口让工人进行沟通;共享环境保留可重复使用的调查结果和工作意图。 为了测试Agensh的可伸缩性,我们用GPT-5.6-sol(高)来评价这五个最难的方案本奇任务. 平均最终测试率从19.31%提高到28.78%,相对改善约49%。 较大的组织更早达到类似的考试通过率。 在胰岛素上,从1个剂放大到1 024个剂,最终测试通过率从33.89%提高到55.06%。 工人的轨迹进一步表明,随着组织的发展,不同形式的自我组织合作逐渐出现并标准化. 这些结果显示,代理人的数量是多代理组织扩大一般情报领域的一个新的规模化方面,为困难的暂时性限制或时间预算下的复杂任务提供了一个实际的解决办法。

articles.title: SpeakerMem-R1: Speaker-Centered Dual-Track Memory for Multi-Party Dialogue
articles.content: Long-term conversational memory in multi-party settings requires more than retrieving relevant content from long-term conversations: it must distinguish who said what, whom each statement concerns, how individuals perceive one another, what information is shared by the group, and how states change over time. Recent studies on multi-party dialogue benchmarks show that existing general-purpose LLM memory systems tend to lose person and group relations or struggle to integrate clues distributed across members, groups, and time. Together, these issues reveal two core bottlenecks: message attribution and relational understanding in multi-party dialogue, and state reconstruction from interleaved histories. To address both, we propose $\textbf{SpeakerMem-R1}$: its dual-track memory stores speaker-labeled verbatim messages and derived states organized into person-level and group-level views, then combines evidence from both tracks by entity, event, and time at query time. To reduce attribution and update errors during structured memory construction while enabling local deployment, we train Writer-R1 with SpeakerLevenshtein and speaker-conditioned GRPO. On GroupMemBench, SocialMemBench, and EverMemBench, SpeakerMem-R1 achieves binary accuracies of 47.9%, 69.2%, and 61.9%, respectively. On the publicly reported EverMemBench leaderboard from EverMind-AI, we achieves 62.33%, the best reported result among the latest state-of-the-art frameworks. It also achieves 70.85% on all 1,986 LoCoMo questions, which we use as a two-person long-term conversation boundary test. In a controlled evaluation of 305 questions, RL raises the SFT Writer's mean accuracy from 57.38% to 68.20%. We report both binary accuracy and token-F1, and ablations show that the verbatim and structured tracks, as well as person-level and group-level views, are complementary under the standardized evaluation interface.

articles.title_zh: 议长Mem-R1:以议长为中心的多党对话双轨记忆
articles.content_zh: 多党环境下的长期对话记忆需要的不仅仅是从长期对话中检索相关内容:它必须区分谁说出什么,每个声明都涉及谁,个人如何彼此感知,集体共享哪些信息,以及状态如何随时间变化. 近期关于多党对话基准的研究表明,现有的通用LLM记忆系统往往会失去人和团体关系,或为整合分布在成员,团体,时间之间的线索而挣扎. 这些问题共同揭示了两个核心瓶颈:多党对话中的信息归属和关系理解,以及国家从互不关联的历史中重建。 为了解决这两个问题,我们提议$\textbf{speakerMem-R1}$:它的双轨内存存储器,标注在扬声器上的逐字记录和衍生的状态,被组织成人级和群级视图,然后按照实体、事件和查询时间将两轨证据合并在一起。 为了减少结构内存构建过程中的归属和更新错误,同时允许本地部署,我们用SpeakerLevenshtein和扬声器条件GPRO来训练Writer-R1. 在GroupMem Bench, SocialMem Bench, 以及EverMem Bench, 演讲人, Mem-R1分别实现47.9%,69.2%和61.9%的二进制速率. 在EverMind-AI公开报道的EverMem Bench领导板上,我们取得了62.33%的成绩,这是最新最新最新框架中报告的最佳结果。 它还在所有1,986个LoCoMo问题上实现了70.85%,我们用它们作为两个人长期对话的边界测试. 在对305个问题进行控制评价时,RL将SFT Writer的平均精度从57.38%提高到68.20%. 我们报告二进制精度和符号-F1以及模拟显示,逐字记录和结构化的轨道,以及人级和集团级的视图,在标准化评价接口下是相辅相成的。

articles.title: Beyond Repeated Sampling: Learning Search Policies for LLM Reasoning
articles.content: Large language models increasingly tackle hard reasoning problems by spending more test-time compute, yet the dominant strategy remains naive repeated sampling: draw many independent solutions and hope one is correct. Because such sampling explores only through local decoding noise, it tends to produce many near duplicate attempts rather than genuinely different ideas. We ask whether exploration can instead be steered at a semantic level, by first sampling problem specific concepts, hints, or strategies and then conditioning answer generation on them. We refine this into a simple, more exploratory procedure that emits many diverse concepts in a single trajectory, and evaluate it on hard problems where repeated sampling struggles. We then go a step further and make concept generation trainable: a small concept generator is optimized with reinforcement learning so that its concepts maximize the downstream success of a larger, frozen answer generator. On hard mathematical reasoning problems, the trained concept generator substantially improves the answer generator's pass@k over naive repeated sampling at the same answer generation allocation, surpasses concepts drawn from much larger untuned models, and transfers to answer generators it was never trained against, including a model from a different family. A small model can thus be trained into an effective, reusable search policy for a much larger one.

articles.title_zh: Beyond 重复抽样: LLM 学习搜索政策 理由说明
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地通过花费更多的测试时间计算来解决硬推理问题,然而主导策略仍然是天真的重复抽样:绘制许多独立的解决方案,希望一个是正确的. 由于这种取样只通过局部解码噪声进行探索,因此往往会产生许多接近重复的尝试,而不是真正不同的想法. 我们问,是否可以在语义层面指导勘探工作,首先取样具体问题的具体概念、提示或策略,然后对这些概念、提示或策略进行限定。 我们把它细化成一个简单,更探索性的程序,将许多不同的概念放入一个单一的轨迹中,并在重复的采样斗争的艰难问题上加以评价. 然后,我们再走一步,使概念生成可以训练:一个小型概念生成器通过强化学习得到优化,从而使其概念最大限度地实现更大的冷冻解答生成器的下游成功。 关于硬数学推理问题,训练有素的概念生成器大大改进了答案生成器在同一个答案生成分配时的天真重复取样,超越了从大得多的未调节模型中提取的概念,并转移给它用来回答从未训练过的生成器,包括来自不同家庭的模型. 因此,可以将一个小型模式培训成一个有效、可重复使用的搜索政策,以寻找一个更大的模式。

articles.title: Measuring the Serving Stack Instead of the Model: Hidden Confounds in Local Tool-Use Evaluation
articles.content: A coding agent must emit a valid tool call--a parseable invocation of a tool in the provided schema--before the harness can execute its chosen action. We study how local serving stacks affect this protocol step and show that measured outcomes can depend on the serving layer rather than model behavior alone. In Ollama, the default tools= request is gated per model by a static template flag: some models are accepted and return calls as text, some return native tool_calls, while Phi-3 and Gemma-3 are rejected before inference. In our harness, rejection and retry exhaustion are not preserved as structured failure metadata, so downstream analysis can misclassify them as model non-calls and naively report 0% fidelity. Adding a text tool list while retaining the native channel recovers much of the measured fidelity for accepted models, whereas a uniform text protocol reduces fidelity for Llama-3.2, which has native tool-call support. Cross-stack probes on Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, and SGLang show different handling of the same request. Constrained decoding removes parse failures but can induce non-termination, and turn-pooled versus per-instance estimates differ by up to about 55 points. We conclude with a checklist for treating serving behavior as part of the evaluation protocol.

articles.title_zh: 衡量服务堆栈而不是模型:本地工具使用评价中隐藏的缺陷
articles.content_zh: 编码代理必须发出一个有效的工具呼叫-a解析地引用所提供计划中的一项工具-,然后才能执行它选定的行动。 我们研究局部服务堆栈如何影响这个协议步骤,并显示测量的结果可以依赖于服务层,而不是单靠模型行为. 在Ollama中,默认工具=请求通过静态模板旗为每个模型加门:一些模型被接受并返回呼叫作为文本,一些返回本地工具_calls,而Phi-3和Gemma-3则在推论前被拒绝. 在我们的操纵下,拒绝和重试疲劳没有保存为结构化的失败元数据,所以下游分析可能将它们错误地归类为模型无召和天真地报告0%的忠诚. 添加文本工具列表,同时保留本地通道可以恢复大部分被接受模型的测量忠诚度,而统一文本协议则降低了Llama-3.2的忠诚度,后者有本地工具调用支持. 在Ollama,llama.cpp,vLLM,和SGLang上的交叉存储探测器显示对同一请求的不同处理. 受约束的解码可以消除解析失败,但可以诱导非终止,转动集合与每次内测的估计相差约55分. 我们最后提出了一份清单,将服务行为作为评估协议的一部分。

articles.title: Detecting GPT-Assisted Writing Using Interpretable Stylometric Features
articles.content: Distinguishing GPT-assisted from independently authored student writing has become a critical challenge in academia. This paper evaluates the discriminative capability of interpretable stylometric features extracted solely from submitted text. Using data from 90 participants who wrote both independently and with ChatGPT assistance, we evaluate eight machine learning classifiers while keeping data from the same participant together during validation. On the held-out test set, Random Forest achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.87 and an F1-score of 0.84, with False Positive and False Negative rates of 22.2% and 11.1%, respectively. SHAP analysis shows that lexical and grammatical characteristics drive the resulting predictions. The findings suggest that transparent, text-intrinsic features provide measurable signal for detecting GPT-assisted writing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用可解释的形状特性检测 TPT 辅助写作
articles.content_zh: 区分GPT协助与独立作者的学生写作,已成为学术界的关键性挑战. 本文件评价了仅从提交的案文中提取的可解释性定型特征的歧视性能力。 我们利用独立写作和在ChatGPT协助下写作的90名参与者的数据,评估了8个机器学习分类器,同时在验证过程中将同一参与者的数据放在一起. 在停产测试中,Random Forest取得了0.87的ROC-AUC和0.84的F1-分数,假正负率和假负率分别为22.2%和11.1%。 SHAP分析显示,词汇学和语法特征驱动了由此产生的预测. 研究结果表明,透明、文字内涵的特征为检测GPT辅助写作提供了可衡量的信号。

articles.title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
articles.content: Integrating heterogeneous datasets within data lakes is a critical challenge, particularly for semantically related tables that lack the explicit attributes needed to be joined. We study Discovery-Driven Integration, where the relevant sources and their missing relational structure must be discovered before integration. In this setting, unstructured text provides the evidence that connects otherwise disjoint tables. The fundamental challenge is to discover the relationships at a fine-grained level that connect individual rows from different tables through specific sentences. We formalize this task as Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery and propose a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention architecture called LOKI Latent-space Optimization for Knowledge Integration) that learns contextualized representations of table rows and sentences. Through a global table-text contrastive objective, fine-grained row-sentence associations emerge without explicit local supervision. Existing multi-modal discovery methods largely retrieve coarse-grained column-text associations, whereas integration systems assume supplied row-text links, schemas, or queries. LOKI instead transforms these implicit associations into explicit, interpretable join paths, organizes them into relation-consistent groups, and materializes them as typed integrated tables with sentence-level provenance. Comprehensive evaluations on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LOKI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-modal data discovery approaches, and materializes typed integrated tables with 0.982 macro typed-pair precision while being up to 40 times cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.

articles.title_zh: 通过文本对脱节表进行解析
articles.content_zh: 整合数据湖中的各种数据集是一项关键的挑战,特别是对缺乏需要加入的明确属性的与整体相关的表格而言。 我们研究发现 - 驱动整合,在整合前必须先发现相关来源及其缺失的关系结构. 在此设置中,非结构化文本提供了连接原本脱节的表格的证据. 根本的挑战是在精细的层次上发现通过具体句子将不同表格中的单个行连接起来的关系. 我们将此任务正式化为Text-Mediated join Path Discovery,并提议一个横向双向交叉关注架构,名为LOKI Latent-Space Optimization for Knowledge Intoduction),学习表格行和句子的上下文化表述. 通过全球表格文本对比性目标,在没有明确地方监督的情况下,出现了精细的排刑协会。 现有的多式发现方法大多检索粗细的列纹连接,而集成系统则假设所提供的行纹链接、计划或查询。 相反,LOKI将这些隐含的关联转变为明确、可解释的结合路径,将它们组织成符合关系的群体,并将其变成带有句子层次来源的打字式综合表格。 对现实世界基准的综合评价表明,LOKI的绩效始终高于最新水平的多模式数据发现方法,并实现了0.982宏型打法精确度的输入式综合表格,而LLM API成本比直接提示成本低40倍。

articles.title: Diffusion Drafts, AR Verifies: Accelerating Document OCR with Self-Speculative Decoding
articles.content: Autoregressive OCR vision-language models accurately convert document images into text and structured markup, but require one sequential decoding step per output token, limiting inference speed. Unlike open-ended text generation, OCR outputs are strongly grounded in the input image, making diffusion-based parallel generation promising. However, when several tokens are predicted in one diffusion step, each is predicted before the others are known. Committing them directly can therefore introduce errors. We therefore introduce GravityOCR, a parameter-shared AR-block-diffusion model jointly trained for parallel drafting and causal AR verification. Verifying drafts before commitment lets the model commit multiple output tokens per round without a separate drafting network. The causal AR path also enables GRPO with sequence- and structure-level OCR rewards, avoiding diffusion-trajectory likelihood estimation while updating the shared drafter parameters. On OmniDocBench v1.6, AR-path GRPO improves the Overall score from 94.92 to 95.16 without reducing diffusion drafting efficiency, while the final model remains close to the original GLM-OCR score of 95.48. In an SGLang serving deployment, GravityOCR commits an average of 9.7 output tokens per forward pass and achieves a $3.94\times$ decode-only speedup on region crops and a $1.32\times$ end-to-end page-processing speedup over AR decoding.
